top_signals.title: Gold Falls as Traders Weigh Rate-Hike Prospects, Inflation Fears
top_signals.summary: Gold fell to a two-month low as the dollar strengthened, while heightened Middle East tensions fueled fears over war-driven inflation and investors weighed prospects for at least one more US rate hike this year.
